audits.riverside_integrity: Authoritative Part81 and Part97 blob readback confirms Riverside CO 126,137 kg was not previously retained. However the current dual-year table has only one visible value for CO and flattened extraction does not preserve whether the blank is in 2024 or 2025. Exact permit/value web and repository searches did not independently resolve the year, so the row is deliberately not promoted.
audits.allington_error_prevention: Single-value rows in dual-year tables are never assigned to 2024 from flattened text alone. This is the explicit safeguard learned from the corrected Allington 2025-only misattribution.
audits.broad_gas_policy: CO, SOx and NMVOC are eligible gas-scope pollutants when an explicit target-year Air annual mass exists; absence of a distinct row is not converted to zero.
audits.prior_blob_policy: Repository search-index misses are not treated as uniqueness proof. Part81/97 authoritative candidate arrays were read directly before assessing Riverside CO.
audits.direct_row_policy: No direct Environment Agency 2024 PI facility row was consumed. Public resource discovery still resolves a ZIP distribution rather than an accessible row-level API/CSV in this runtime; confidence promotion remains unavailable.
audits.zero_policy: Blank, ambiguous, later-year and absent rows remain no-data, never zero.
